# [ShadowClaw DAW](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/)

> In-browser Digital Audio Workstation template powered by ShadowClaw. Features zero-dependency Web Audio API synthesis, TC39 Signals, custom Web Components, declarative WebMCP tools, and autonomous agent composition skills.

## Workbench & Interactive Surface

- [Interactive Workbench](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/): Real-time Web Audio API synthesis, step sequencer, mixer console with peak meters, and offline WAV bouncing.

## Documentation Guides

- [Architecture](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/architecture/): Four-tier runtime architecture, Web Audio graph, lookahead scheduler, OPFS storage, and signal reactivity.
- [WebMCP Tools](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/tools/): 25 declarative `scdaw_*` tools for agentic music production, MIDI/DAWproject interchange, and stem exports.
- [Agent Skills](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/skills/): Autonomous slash skills (`/beat`, `/jam`, `/mixdown`, `/bounce`, `/scdaw-status`, `/scdaw-doctor`).
- [Workbench UI](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/workbench/): 11 mobile-first custom elements (`<scdaw-workbench>`, `<scdaw-transport>`, `<scdaw-browser>`, `<scdaw-timeline>`, `<scdaw-editor>`, `<scdaw-sequencer>`, `<scdaw-devices>`, `<scdaw-mixer>`, `<scdaw-knob>`, `<scdaw-resize-handle>`, `<scdaw-statusbar>`).
- [Porting & Attribution](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/porting-and-attribution/): Provenance ledger and porting map from openDAW (AGPL-3.0-or-later).
- [Troubleshooting](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/troubleshooting/): Browser audio autoplay policy, leader election, and offline bounce tips.

## Related

- [ShadowClaw](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/llms.txt): Core dual-runtime AI assistant framework.
- [openDAW](https://github.com/andremichelle/openDAW): Web audio workstation source reference.
